verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is on-premises GPU hardware (a DGX/HGX server platform), not a hosted service that holds a user's account data, so "export all my data and leave" is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes compute, memory, storage drives, and OS support, with no vendor-held data store from which an export would apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
